posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Sleep is when your skin regenerates — growth hormone peaks at night.
Missing sleep ages your skin faster than sun exposure.
posts.cta: Sleep is your skin's repair time.

posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Gum disease bacteria have been found in arterial plaques.
Your dental hygiene affects your heart.
posts.cta: Gum disease is a heart disease risk factor.
